Name: Profile Back
Author: CaviarTheCatgirl
Description: Boards you can open from any profile, and a Back key that takes you straight back to where you came from. Board Back steps back through boards, as deep as you go.

Actions.Name: Open Board
Actions.Tooltip: Opens one of your boards. The first press of a new board installs it (Stream Deck asks once).

Actions.Name: Back
Actions.Tooltip: On a board: back to the normal profile you came from (e.g. your game), however many boards deep.

Actions.Name: Board Back
Actions.Tooltip: On a board: one step back to the previous board. On the first board it works like Back.
